about: What the folder sidebar must list for this folder, in its order (folders first, then files, each by name), once the files below are added. Both builds check it: tests/e2e/folder.spec.mjs (the browser's walk) and desktop/scripts/run-self-test.mjs --expect folder (the shell's mdv_list_directory, which also lists the sibling file the runner adds). The added files are created at run time because git cannot store a folder named .git and node_modules is in .gitignore; none of them may be listed.
